schema_priority_order: Current exact new cash price x actual unit age x condition, capped by fresh resale / (1 + legacy markup) or resale x (1 - explicit gross margin), minimum 8% gross margin; kit, battery, fold risk, repairs and fixed costs included; assessed Cashify uplift bounded by same cap
_meta.calibration_protocol: Every refresh checks every domestic catalogue model and exact RAM/storage/size/connectivity variant, including old, discontinued and nonphone models. International derivations are reviewed separately. Per-model source checks and pending reasons are mandatory; price-specific dates never advance without evidence.

_meta.v3_1_changelog: MAJOR PRICING FIX. Root cause: engine was anchoring on Cashify REFURBISHED-RETAIL (sell) price, which produced buyback quotes that were too LOW after deductions. Fix: new 'cashify_exchange' field = what Cashify actually PAYS the customer (their exchange/sell-old-phone value), and new Mode 0 in engine: RT buyback A1 = cashify_exchange × (1 + RT_premium). RT pays a tier-based premium ABOVE Cashify (S:8% A:10% B:12% C:14% D:16%) to beat Cashify's lowball and win the walk-in. 100 high-traffic models now have verified/estimated Cashify exchange values (iPhone 11-16 series, Samsung S23/24/25 Ultra+S24, Z Fold 5, OnePlus 11/12R/10 Pro). Verified anchors: iPhone 14 ₹14,720, Samsung S24 ₹22,000. Both JS engine and Python engine updated with Mode 0.

cashify_buyback_widget_is_fake.event: The "Approx. Buyback Value" on Cashify price pages is a template printing 40% of the listed price - identical on Fold8, Fold8 Ultra and iPhone 17 Pro Max.

market_signals.rule: When a successor flagship is confirmed <~4 weeks out, trim outgoing-gen resale anchors 5-10%; once it actually launches, drop the anticipatory trim and re-anchor on observed resale. Festival-sale (Prime Day/BBD) lows are a TEMPORARY NET_NEW floor: cap buyback below them, but revert the anchor to trend after the sale unless it is a confirmed permanent price cut. NEVER add a model whose India launch_date is still in the future.

announced_vs_on_sale.effect: Gap-adds are held until the confirmed FIRST-SALE date, not the announcement date.
